use_cases: Display user profile images in comment sections
Show author attribution on blog posts
Represent users in chat and messaging interfaces
Display team member photos in about pages
Show speaker or contributor avatars in event pages
ai_summary: A minimalist Avatar component built on Radix UI primitives for displaying user profile images with automatic fallback support for missing images. Uses Tailwind CSS for styling with a rounded-full design. The component exports Avatar, AvatarImage, and AvatarFallback primitives that can be composed for various user representation needs across any platform.
